statements.context: SUBJECT: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE LITIGATION TASK FORCE President Trump has been clear: "United States leadership in Artificial Intelligence (AI) will promote United States national and economic security and dominance across many domains."1 "United States AI companies must be free to innovate without cumbersome regulation," and "State-by-State regulation by definition creates a patchwork of 50 different regulatory regimes that makes compliance more challenging, particularly for start-ups."2 Accordingly, the President has made it "the policy ofthe United States to sustain and enhance the United States' global AI dominance through a minimally burdensome national policy framework for AI."3 Consistent with that policy, I am hereby "establish[ing] an AI Litigation Task Force (Task Force) whose sole responsibility shall be to challenge State AI laws inconsistent with the policy."

statements.context: SUBJECT: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE LITIGATION TASK FORCE President Trump has been clear: "United States leadership in Artificial Intelligence (AI) will promote United States national and economic security and dominance across many domains."1 "United States AI companies must be free to innovate without cumbersome regulation," and "State-by-State regulation by definition creates a patchwork of 50 different regulatory regimes that makes compliance more challenging, particularly for start-ups."2 Accordingly, the President has made it "the policy ofthe United States to sustain and enhance the United States' global AI dominance through a minimally burdensome national policy framework for AI."3 Consistent with that policy, I am hereby "establish[ing] an AI Litigation Task Force (Task Force) whose sole responsibility shall be to challenge State AI laws inconsistent with the policy."4 The Task Force shall challenge such State AI laws "on grounds that such laws unconstitutionally regulate interstate commerce, are preempted by existing Federal regulations, or are otherwise unlawful." I or my designee will serve as the Chair of the Task Force, and the Associate Attorney General will serve as the Vice Chair.
